summary: Verified the changed documentation for LongAccumulator's stepping, mutation, traversal, specialized transformations, counting, factories/conversion, serialization proxy, and LongAccumulatorStepper operations against their implementations; the documented return values, mutation, boxing, exhaustion, splitting, and exception behavior are accurate.

bonus_findings.issue: The pre-existing documentation omits that this method throws IllegalArgumentException when the accumulator has more than Int.MaxValue elements.
bonus_findings.suggestion: Add an @throws IllegalArgumentException tag describing the size limit.
